title: player.pos
description: The hidden player's cell. Sent at each step start (target cell) and on non-step changes.

kind.description: FA0 (FIELD_MECHANICS_AUDIT_PLAN): ice (a slide on an ice tile, one message per cell) is optional and sent by no adapter before FA8; a client that doesn't know a kind follows it as a forced move.

frames.description: How long the move takes; 0 for an instant change.

elev.description: WATER_AND_BRIDGES_PLAN D7 (Gen 3 only): the hidden game's elevation of the player (the engine's current one, not the cell's); on a bridge cell (elevation 15) it names the floor: the deck's elevation stands on the deck, any other under it. Optional; absent: the deck, or the floor nearest the player's feet.

jump.description: BIKE_PLAN D6 (Gen 3 only): the step is a bike hop (low: a bunny hop onto the next cell; normal: a side jump; high: a wheelie's ledge hop, kind ledge). Optional.

n.description: The move.step this answers, if any.
